## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the relevant accepted decisions.
- [ ] Tests appropriate to changed behavior pass; regression or visual evidence is included where needed.
- [ ] Source XML and affected documentation/coverage are updated, or the change does not affect them.
- [ ] Required Release, coverage and Wiki generation checks ran before the repository commit.
- [ ] Verification limits, migration requirements and known remaining issues are described above.
